items.title: 機管局應用「自動噴油機械人」跑道劃線及標識 工序需時減三分二
items.summary: 本港機場今年9月起應用「自動噴油機械人」，在跑道上劃上不同線條及標識，為全球首個應用機械人進行有關工序的機場。 機管局表示，三條跑道合共長超過11公里，跑道上有多種不同線條及標識，指引飛機升降，而有關跑道標識須每周至每半年重劃一次。局方一般會每晚輪流封閉其中一條跑道維修，並通宵劃線。…
items.titleEn: Automated spraying robots, which are designed to draw lines and mark the runway, have reduced the process time by two-thirds
items.summaryEn: Since September this year, Hong Kong Airport has been using "automatic spraying robots" to designate different lines and signage on runways, making it the first airport in the world to use a robot for this process. According to the Air Traffic Administration, the three runways have a total length of more than 11 kilometers, with different lines and signs on the runways to guide the aircraft up and down, while the associated runway signs must be re-designed once a week or every six months. The local authorities typically close one of the runways every night and repair it and line it up all night. I'm not going to lie.

items.title: 維港泳將舉行 灣仔北及尖沙咀將實施特別交通及運輸安排
items.summary: 維港泳早上舉行，大約4000名泳手參與，由灣仔金紫荊廣場公眾碼頭出發，以尖沙咀星光大道為終點。灣仔北及尖沙咀將實施特別交通及運輸安排，期間水上的士及渡輪航線將暫停服務。 其中位於金紫荊廣場外的一段博覽道東，包括上落客區，凌晨零時30分至下午約1時臨時封閉。因應灣仔及尖沙咀的登岸梯級封閉，來往尖東至中環的水上的士，將取消今日上午10時40分、11時20分及下午12時10分由尖東開出的班次。…
items.titleEn: Viphong Swimming will be held in the North Bay and Minas Gerais, and special transportation and transportation arrangements will be implemented
items.summaryEn: The morning of the event, which was attended by around 4,000 swimmers, started from the public harbour of Wangyuan, and ended with the Minas Gerais Lightway. North Bay and Minas Gerais will implement special transport and transport arrangements, while taxi and ferry services on the water will be suspended. One section of the exhibition hall, which is located east of the Qingdao Square, including the Upper and Lower Guesthouses, is temporarily closed from 030 am to around 1 pm. As a result of the closure of the waterfront staircases in Bayou and Minas Gerais, water taxi services to and from the tip of the peninsula will be cancelled at 10:40 a.m., 11:20 a.m. and 12:10 p.m. today. I'm not going to lie.

items.title: 港珠澳大橋香港段半馬今早舉行 警方實施臨時交通安排
items.summary: 港珠澳大橋（香港段）半馬拉松今早舉行，警方為配合賽事，將於介乎港珠澳大橋香港口岸與粵港分界線之間的一段港珠澳大橋香港連接路，實施臨時交通安排，並視乎比賽實際完畢時間及直至道路重開供車輛使用為止。 警方表示，首階段由昨日下午4時起，封閉該段港珠澳大橋香港連接路往香港方向的左線及中線，前往香港的駕駛者須使用相關路段的右線。…
items.titleEn: The Hong Kong half-mile section of the Pearl Harbor Bridge was held this morning, police implemented temporary transportation arrangements
items.summaryEn: The half-marathon was held earlier this morning and the police will cooperate in the race to implement temporary transport arrangements between the Port of Hong Kong Bridge and the Port of South Australia Bridge, a link between the port of Hong Kong and the boundary line between the Port and the Port, depending on the actual time of the race and until the roads are reopened to vehicles. Police said that the first stage, which started at 4pm yesterday, closed the left and middle lines of the Hong Kong-to-Hong Kong link to the section of the Pearl Harbor Bridge, and that drivers heading to Hong Kong must use the right line of the relevant section of the route. I'm not going to lie.

items.title: 方保僑料迪士尼票務系統或存漏洞 攻擊者大量擷取第三方平台憑證
items.summary: 香港迪士尼樂園證實發現網絡事件。據了解，香港迪士尼樂園有1萬7千個二維碼在網上票務系統中懷疑被盜取，現已暫停運作官方票務系統。警方將案暫列作「有犯罪或不誠實意圖而取用電腦」調查，暫未有人被捕。香港迪士尼表示，已即時採取跟進及防護措拖，並加强入場時門票核實程序。 香港資訊科技商會榮譽會長方保僑相信，相關系統是被黑客入侵，在未調查清楚有否客戶資料被盜前，暫停相關網上票務運作，是恰當及必要的應變處理。…
items.titleEn: The company claims that the attackers have taken advantage of a large number of third-party platforms and that they have been accused of corrupting the company's ticketing system.
items.summaryEn: In Hong Kong, Disney Park confirmed the detection of cyber incidents. According to reports, 17,000 2D codes in Hong Kong's Disney Park are suspected of being stolen from the online ticketing system, and the official ticketing system has now been suspended. The police have listed the case as a "crime or dishonest intent computer-based" investigation, and no arrests have been made. Hong Kong-based Disney said it has taken immediate steps to monitor and protect the delay and strengthen the ticketing process at the entrance. The Hon'ble Chairman of the Hong Kong Information Technology Chamber of Commerce believes that the relevant system has been hacked and that suspending the relevant online checkout operations before it is clear whether customer data has been stolen is the appropriate and necessary response. I'm not going to lie.

items.title: 寄艙行李被檢市值約180萬元懷疑可卡因 海關拘印尼籍旅客
items.summary: 海關昨日在機場偵破一宗旅客販運毒品案件，檢獲約3公斤懷疑可卡因，估計市值約180萬元，拘捕一名男子。 海關表示，一名57歲印尼籍男旅客昨日從哥倫比亞波哥大經巴西聖保羅及卡塔爾多哈，飛抵本港。海關人員清關時，在他的寄艙行李箱的夾層中發現該批懷疑可卡因。 編輯：鍾慧儀
items.titleEn: The Indonesian passengers were detained by the Customs on suspicion of cocaine with a market value of about 1.8 million yuan.
items.summaryEn: Customs detected a drug trafficking case yesterday at the airport, seized about 3 kilograms of suspected cocaine, estimated to be worth about 1.8 million yuan, and arrested a man. Customs said that a 57-year-old Indonesian passenger had flown from Bogota, Colombia, via São Paulo and Qatar to Port of Bengal yesterday. When the customs officers cleared the door, the suspected cocaine was found in the trunk of his mailbox. This is the first time I've seen this.

items.title: 孫玉菡出席社福界界別分組候選人見面會 籲選民積極投票
items.summary: 2026年選舉委員會界別分組一般選舉，社會福利界界別分組將有25位候選人競逐15個選任席位。勞工及福利局局長孫玉菡今天到灣仔戴麟趾夫人訓練中心體育館，出席社會福利界界別分組候選人見面會。 孫玉菡在局方社交專頁表示，出席見面會的各候選人進行自我介紹，並闡述了對社福服務發展的見解。超過170位同工聽取了候選人的介紹。有效登記為社福界界別分組當然委員的人士亦出席見面會，支持這場重要選舉。…
items.titleEn: Sun Yat-sen attends a meeting of social welfare candidates and urges voters to vote proactively
items.summaryEn: In the general election of 2026 the Election Commission will have 25 candidates competing for 15 seats in the Social Welfare Division. The head of the Department of Labor and Welfare, Sun Yue, visited the Taipei Women's Training Center Stadium today to attend a meeting of candidates for various social welfare categories. In a statement posted on the local social media page, Sun Yuen said that the candidates who attended the meeting presented themselves and expressed their views on the development of social welfare services. More than 170 colleagues listened to the candidates' presentations. People who are already registered as members of the Committee on Social Welfare also attended the meeting to support this important election. I'm not going to lie.

items.summary: 據了解，香港迪士尼樂園偵測到公司電腦系統有異常活動，1.7萬個二維碼在網上票務系統中懷疑被盜取，已就事件報警，並停止網上票務運作。 警方表示，昨日接獲一間公司報案，指懷疑有網絡事件。經初步調查，案件暫列「有犯罪或不誠實意圖而取用電腦」，交由大嶼山警區重案組跟進，暫未有人被捕。…
items.titleEn: In Hong Kong, Disney's official website suspends ticket sales after it was revealed that the ticketing system suspects 170,000 2D codes were stolen.
items.summaryEn: According to reports, Hong Kong Disney Park detected abnormal activity in the company's computer system, 17,000 2D codes in the online ticketing system were suspected of being stolen, and the incident was reported and the online ticket office was shut down. Police said they received a report yesterday from a company suspected of cyberattacks. The case was initially investigated by a "criminal or dishonest intent computer" task force and was handed over to the Da Nang Police Department, who have not yet arrested anyone. items.title: 香港迪士尼樂園發現網絡事件 警方暫列不誠實意圖而取用電腦
items.summary: 香港迪士尼樂園昨日發現網絡事件，已經報警，並即時採取跟進及防護措施。樂園強烈建議旅客，應直接從樂園官方渠道或透過合作旅行社及平台購買樂園門票，切勿光顧不可靠來源的賣家，免招不便及經濟損失。如有懷疑，應立即尋求警方協助。 樂園已加强入場時門票核實程序，並將盡快通知個人資料私隱專員公署。 警方回覆查詢表示，昨日接獲一間公司報案，指懷疑有網絡事件。經初步調查，案件暫列「有犯罪或不誠實意圖而取用電腦」，交由大嶼山警區重案組跟進，暫未有人被捕。…
items.titleEn: Hong Kong's Disney Park has detected cyber incidents and police have temporarily seized computers for dishonest intent
items.summaryEn: In Hong Kong, Disney Park detected cyber incidents yesterday, reported to the police, and immediately took steps to follow up and protect against them. The park strongly advises travelers to purchase park tickets directly from the park's official channels or through cooperative travel agencies and platforms, and not to look to sellers from unreliable sources to avoid inconvenience and economic losses. If you have any doubts, you should seek immediate help from the police. The park has stepped up its ticket verification process at the entrance and will notify the privacy experts of personal data as soon as possible. Police responded to the inquiry and said they received a report yesterday from a company suspected of cyberattacks. The case was initially investigated by a "criminal or dishonest intent computer" task force and was handed over to the Da Nang Police Department, who have not yet arrested anyone. I'm not going to lie.

items.title: 截至傍晚6時 16班來往美國與香港航班取消或延誤
items.summary: 美國聯邦航空管理局一度下令全美所有航班停飛，停飛令維持約4小時後解除。本港機管局表示，今日原定有16班航班由美國抵港，以及17班航班由香港出發前往美國。截至晚上6時，全日有3班由美國抵港的航班取消、6班航班延誤；離港前往美國有2班航班取消、5班航班延誤。 機管局指，美國相關航空交通限制已經解除，但預計今明兩日來往美國及香港的航班將受到一定程度影響，呼籲旅客留意航空公司的最新公布。 編輯：鍾慧儀
items.titleEn: 16 flights to the United States and Hong Kong have been cancelled or delayed as of 6pm
items.summaryEn: The Federal Aviation Administration once ordered all flights across the United States to be suspended and the suspension was lifted after about four hours. According to the Port Authority, 16 flights from the United States to and from Hong Kong to the United States were scheduled today, as well as 17 flights from Hong Kong. As of 6 p.m., three flights to and from the U.S. port have been canceled, six have been delayed, two have been cancelled, and five have been postponed from the port to the United States. The air traffic control authority has said that the restrictions on U.S. air travel have been lifted, but that flights to the United States and Hong Kong are expected to be affected to some extent over the next two days, urging passengers to pay attention to the latest airline announcements. This is the first time I've seen this.

items.title: 麥美娟：物管公司及物業管理業監管局會抽查核實「授權票」
items.summary: 政府完成就修訂《建築物管理條例》的公眾諮詢，建議大維修工程業主大會的法定開會人數維持一成。民政及青年事務局局長麥美娟出席本台節目時表示，是考慮到部分業主擔心提高法定人數，會增加召開會議的困難。 對於核實「授權票」，麥美娟表示，物業管理公司及物業管理業監管局都會抽查。 編輯︰王濱南
items.titleEn: McMillan: Property management companies and the Real Estate Regulatory Authority will check the validity of the "license"
items.summaryEn: The government has completed a public consultation on amending the Building Management Regulations and recommended that the number of members of the General Assembly of Repair Owners be kept at 10%. In a speech on the platform, the director of the Office of Civil Affairs and Youth, Mike Meehan, said that due to concerns from some business owners about increasing the number of legal staff, it would be more difficult to hold meetings. In a press release, McMillan said that the property management company and the Real Estate Management Authority will also be screened for "licensing".
